objective: Test a small library of simple, economically distinct cross-sectional alphas and advance only factors that add cost-adjusted information beyond the qualified VCB/incumbent book.

families.residual_reversal: negative 7-day return residualized cross-sectionally against 28-day return; rank positive reversal scores only; inverse 21-day volatility sizing
families.liquidity_acceleration: positive 28-day momentum multiplied by improvement in trailing 14-day versus 56-day is_liquid persistence; inverse 21-day volatility sizing
families.crash_resilient_momentum: positive 42-day momentum penalized by trailing 63-day downside semideviation relative to total volatility; inverse 28-day volatility sizing
families.breadth_dispersion_interaction: positive 35-day relative momentum activated continuously when cross-sectional momentum dispersion and positive breadth are jointly above their trailing 63-day medians

selection_rule: No parameter search. Evaluate every frozen family exactly once through 2022. Preserve all failures. A factor may advance only if every advancement gate passes.
forbidden: changing a mechanism after observing economics
